black.use: all text, lines 1pt/1.5pt, icon colour, key-slide pill/tile

red.use: lead accent: info-box fill, chart series 1, table header rule, active tracker tab, agenda panel, Form tab on white/grey, section/closing headline on white & mint

blue.use: chart series 2, frame textbox outline 1pt, lines 1/1.5pt, title colour on 'Titelfolie ohne Bild', quote text on pink, key-slide headline on yellow, Form tab on yellow

warm_grey.use: chart series 3, table row rules 1pt, key tile

olive_yellow.use: chart series 4, section/quote headline on yellow, Form tab on mint

light_grey.use: grey background (master default), chart/info panels on white, agenda number tiles, table total row, inactive tracker tabs

white.use: white background (Weiß layouts), text on red/blue/black fills, picture/chart panels and icon tiles on coloured backgrounds

rules: Only the 6 primary + 3 secondary + white. No tints/shades of theme colours (guide crosses out the tint grid), no Office standard colours.
Secondary colours (mint/pink/cream) are backgrounds only, never text or chart colours.

section_title.color: C4A800 on cream, DB2F16 on white & mint

quote_or_key_headline.color: per layout, inherited: C4A800 Zizat - Gelb, 0074A4 Zitat- Rosa and Key Slide 2 (cream), DB2F16 Zitat - Blau, 000000 Key Slide 1

body_lead_line.note: first line of a text block (guide 'Ebene 1, Mark Pro')

paragraph.align: left everywhere except key pills/agenda numbers (centre)

grid.text_insets: 0 on title/body placeholders; 108000x72000 EMU (0.118x0.079 in) in filled boxes

shapes.corner_style: roundRect everywhere, never sharp boxes for panels; radius ~0.2 in on large panels

panel_full.fill: EBEAE2 on white, FFFFFF on colour

form_tab.desc: vertical rounded pill bleeding off the right (or left) edge

table.total_row: fill EBEAE2, top rule 1pt 8B8A7C, text Mark Pro

logo.type: vector group (7 freeforms) in layouts/master; never redraw

icons.style: monoline, rounded caps/joins, ~2px stroke at 64px, black (000000), no fill, square 1:1
icons.source: unidentified commercial line set (shipped as PNG in the guide)

imagery.style: desaturated, cool-grey architectural/neutral photography; full-bleed only on cover, otherwise inside rounded picture placeholders

capacity.note: cpl = characters per line incl. spaces at the guide size, 10 % below the measured width; lines = lines that fit the box (grow-to-fit boxes: up to the next element below); max_paras = bullet paragraphs that fit (one line each, incl. 3 pt space after); max_words = max_chars / 6.2. Lint/verify simulate real word wrap, these are guidance.

agenda_counts.slots_per_slide: 2-8; layout 'Agenda' (8) or build-time clone 'Agenda k' with slots k+1..8 removed
agenda_counts.over_8: ceil(n/8) slides, balanced (11 -> 6+5), titles 'Agenda' / 'Agenda (continued)', numbering continues
